text: dsh-memory-canvas 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的本地短期记忆插件，通过注册工具让 agent 按需保存和查看任务资料。它可将较长的工具日志或笔记写入 Markdown 引用文件，并把节点加入 Mermaid 任务画布；之后可按节点 ID 找回文本，也可直接查看画布。适合希望把长文本移出当前上下文、同时保留任务线索的 DSH 用户。无需 API Key 或外部账号；默认将数据存于当前工作目录的 .dsh-memory，可用 DSH_MEMORY_DIR 更改目录。

dsh-memory-canvas is a local memory plugin for DSH web. Its tools save notes as Markdown files, add nodes to a Mermaid task canvas, recall text by ID, and display the canvas. Files stay under .dsh-memory by default; DSH_MEMORY_DIR changes the location. No API key or external account is required.
想把很长的工具输出先存起来，需要时再按编号找回。
能不能把任务笔记整理成一张 Mermaid 流程画布？
I want to save a long note outside the chat context and retrieve it later by ID.
dsh-memory-canvas 的功能「保存笔记并加入任务画布」：调用 memory_offload，传入标题和正文；插件将正文写入 Markdown 引用文件，并在 Mermaid 画布中添加节点，返回节点 ID 和文件路径。
dsh-memory-canvas 的功能「按 ID 回读与查看画布」：调用 memory_recall 并提供节点 ID 可取回保存的正文（超过 8 KB 时会截断）；调用 memory_canvas 可读取 Mermaid 任务画布。

dsh-memory-canvas README · dsh-memory-canvas：DeepSeek Harness plugin. Offload bulky tool logs to `refs/*.md`. Keep a Mermaid canvas in context. Recall by `node_id`. Zero daemon.

**CAUTION: don't pip the wrong dsh.** Official CLI: `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`. The PyPI package `deepseek-harness-cli` is a different tool (`dsh doctor` / `dsh chat`).

GitHub topic: `dsh-plugin`. Chinese: [README.zh.md](README.zh.md)

dsh-memory-canvas README · Demo (no dsh)：node demo.mjs

Writes `.dsh-memory/refs/{id}.md`, prints the canvas, recalls by id, and asserts the body matches.

dsh-memory-canvas README · Install into a profile：This package is plain JavaScript. There is no prepare or build step, so a git install does not need allowBuilds.

dsh plugin --profile web add github:guobinmengxiang-rgb/dsh-memory-canvas

Check the composed layer without booting:

dsh --profile web --dump-config

You should see a `dsh-memory-canvas` layer. Then start the profile as usual.

Official CLI is `@deepseek-ai/dsh` (today `0.1.0-rc.6`).

dsh-memory-canvas README · Tools：The agent must call these tools. This plugin does **not** auto-intercept tool logs.

| Tool | Params | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `memory_offload` | `title`, `body` (required) | short `id`, path, `canvas updated` |
| `memory_recall` | `id` (required) | stored body (truncated at 8k with a note) |
| `memory_canvas` | none | Mermaid markdown of the task canvas |

Storage (default): `<cwd>/.dsh-memory/canvas.md` and `<cwd>/.dsh-memory/refs/{id}.md`. Override root with `DSH_MEMORY_DIR`.
dsh-memory-canvas README · Tools：Canvas nodes use a 24-character title. Full text lives in `refs/`.

dsh-memory-canvas README · What this is not：- Not [TencentDB Agent Memory](https://github.com/TencentCloud/TencentDB-Agent-Memory) (not their L0-L3 persona pipeline)
- Not OpenClaw
- Not a vector DB
- Not [Yiipu/dsh-agentmemory](https://github.com/Yiipu/dsh-agentmemory) (that one needs a daemon on `:3111`)

Inspired by Tencent's short-term symbolic memory (MIT idea, our code): refs + Mermaid canvas + `node_id`.

dsh-memory-canvas README · Honest limits：- DeepSeek Harness is a developer preview: THERE WILL BE COMPATIBILITY-BREAKING CHANGES.
- The plugin runs on your machine.
- This bundle `cordis.patch.yml` uses the package name `dsh-memory-canvas`, not a filesystem path.
